propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission and ingestion boundaries via port calls.
All package-root reconciler modules must have zero vendor reach-through: no adapters.jira imports, no lazy-key literals for adapters.jira, and no by-path loads of vendor sibling modules.
Eight vendor modules (acli_subprocess, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, and others) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.
Outbound and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper and compare local-vs-local, building vendor payloads exclusively via injected OutboundMapper at emission.
Backend selection must route through config.reconciler.backend registry with select_backend() and all transport construction sites must use the port rather than provider literals.
Absence probe and rich-text/comment-limit paths must move behind port Protocols (SupportsAbsenceProbe, FieldSanitizer, InboundMapper) to achieve parity with inbound differ canonicalization.
